candidates.name: Get-Service
verified_facts: Get-Service returns objects representing local Windows services, including running and stopped states
Service objects can expose startup type, binary path, dependencies and account context on supported PowerShell versions
semantic_limits: A running service does not prove the canonical runner owns the task, produced receipts or can push to GitHub

candidates.name: Get-ComputerInfo
verified_facts: Get-ComputerInfo returns a consolidated object of Windows system and operating-system properties
Property filters can limit readback to version, boot and host fields needed for a compact receipt
semantic_limits: Host inventory does not prove process ownership, repository cleanliness, network reachability or successful execution

candidates.name: Get-CimInstance
verified_facts: Get-CimInstance returns snapshot objects for a specified CIM class or query
OperationTimeoutSec and explicit property selection can bound and reduce structured diagnostics
semantic_limits: A CIM snapshot is point-in-time supporting evidence and must be correlated with task identity and receipt timestamps

candidates.name: Win32_OperatingSystem
verified_facts: Win32_OperatingSystem represents the installed Windows operating system and exposes boot, build, time-zone and memory properties
The class is a singleton in the Root CIMV2 namespace
semantic_limits: Operating-system uptime and memory availability cannot establish that the recovery script executed or that results are valid

candidates.name: Get-HotFix
verified_facts: Get-HotFix lists installed updates through the Win32_QuickFixEngineering class
Hotfix identifiers and installation dates can be captured as host-context metadata
semantic_limits: Installed-update history does not prove a particular update caused or fixed the recovery failure

candidates.name: W32tm
verified_facts: W32tm is the preferred Windows command-line tool for configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting Windows Time service
Query and stripchart modes can provide time-service and offset diagnostics without changing configuration
semantic_limits: A synchronized clock does not prove receipt authenticity; changing time-service settings is outside this read-only evidence increment

candidates.name: Get-Date
verified_facts: Get-Date returns current date and time and can format or emit UTC values
ISO-style timestamps can be recorded for deterministic receipt chronology
semantic_limits: A local timestamp alone is not trusted freshness evidence unless time-zone and clock-sync context are also recorded

candidates.name: Get-Counter
verified_facts: Get-Counter retrieves Windows performance-counter samples
SampleInterval and MaxSamples can bound collection and prevent indefinite monitoring
semantic_limits: Counter names are localized and short samples do not diagnose causation or prove runner success

candidates.name: Get-Disk
verified_facts: Get-Disk returns disk objects visible to the operating system
Disk number, unique ID, serial number, bus type, health and operational state can identify backing storage
semantic_limits: An online disk does not prove filesystem integrity, free space, write durability or receipt publication

candidates.name: Get-Partition
verified_facts: Get-Partition returns visible partition objects and can filter by drive letter or disk number
Partition objects can be joined to disks and volumes to map the F drive to backing storage
semantic_limits: Partition mapping does not prove volume health, filesystem correctness or atomic file replacement

candidates.name: Get-PhysicalDisk
verified_facts: Get-PhysicalDisk returns physical-disk objects visible through storage management providers
HealthStatus, OperationalStatus, serial, model, media type and size can be captured
semantic_limits: Provider visibility can be incomplete and healthy status does not guarantee absence of transient I/O errors

candidates.name: Get-StorageReliabilityCounter
verified_facts: Get-StorageReliabilityCounter reads device temperature, error, wear, power-on and latency counters when supported
Disk or PhysicalDisk objects can be supplied to target the backing device
semantic_limits: Counters may be unsupported or vendor-dependent; their absence must not be treated as proof of health

candidates.name: Get-StorageAdvancedProperty
verified_facts: Get-StorageAdvancedProperty reads advanced physical-disk properties
Reported properties include device-cache and power-protection state
semantic_limits: Reported cache or power-protection capability does not prove the application performed an fsync-equivalent durable write

candidates.name: Get-PfxCertificate
verified_facts: Get-PfxCertificate returns an object representing a specified PFX certificate file
Certificate subject, issuer, thumbprint and validity metadata can be inspected when the file is accessible
semantic_limits: PFX inspection can prompt for secrets and is not required to prove Git HTTPS trust; private keys must not be exported or logged

candidates.name: Certificate Provider
verified_facts: The PowerShell Certificate provider exposes certificate stores through the Cert drive
Get-ChildItem and Get-Item can filter and inspect certificates, including code-signing and SSL-server-authentication usage
semantic_limits: Certificate-store presence does not prove a remote TLS handshake selected that certificate chain or that Git authentication succeeded

candidates.name: netsh winhttp
verified_facts: netsh winhttp manages and displays WinHTTP proxy settings
The show proxy and show advproxy forms provide read-only configuration context
semantic_limits: WinHTTP proxy settings may differ from Git, browser, user or environment-variable proxy settings; no reset or set action is allowed

candidates.name: Get-NetIPInterface
verified_facts: Get-NetIPInterface returns IPv4 and IPv6 interface configuration, including virtual and loopback interfaces
Interface index, metric, MTU, DHCP and connection state can be correlated with routes
semantic_limits: Interface state and metric do not prove DNS, TLS, Git authentication or remote write permission

candidates.name: Resolve-DnsName
verified_facts: Resolve-DnsName performs DNS queries for specified names
DNS-only, server-targeted, cache-only and quick-timeout modes distinguish live resolution from cached evidence
semantic_limits: Successful name resolution does not prove TCP, TLS, HTTP, Git authorization or repository write access

candidates.name: Test-NetConnection
verified_facts: Test-NetConnection displays diagnostic information for network connections
Detailed TCP and route diagnostics can identify the selected interface, source address and connection result
semantic_limits: A successful TCP test does not prove TLS trust, Git credentials, branch authorization or push success

candidates.name: git status
verified_facts: git status reports differences among HEAD, the index and the working tree and lists untracked paths
Porcelain output is intended for stable scripted parsing
semantic_limits: A clean status does not prove remote synchronization, object integrity, correct branch identity or successful push

candidates.name: git rev-parse
verified_facts: git rev-parse resolves revision parameters and exposes repository and work-tree paths
Commands such as show-toplevel, git-dir and verify can establish local repository identity
semantic_limits: A locally resolved commit does not prove the canonical remote branch still points to the same object

candidates.name: git ls-remote
verified_facts: git ls-remote lists references available in a remote repository with associated object IDs
Exit-code and exact-ref filtering can distinguish communication success from an absent expected ref
semantic_limits: Listing a remote ref proves neither fetch completeness nor permission to push changes

candidates.name: git config
verified_facts: git config reads configuration from system, global, local and worktree scopes
Show-origin and show-scope can identify the source and scope of effective configuration values
semantic_limits: Configuration readback can expose secrets if handled carelessly; credentials and token values must be redacted and no config mutation is allowed

candidates.name: git fsck
verified_facts: git fsck verifies connectivity and validity of objects in the Git object database
Strict, connectivity-only and no-dangling options provide different read-only validation scopes
semantic_limits: A successful fsck does not prove working-tree cleanliness, remote parity, branch authorization or application-level receipt validity
